content:
Olivia: Draft ready for review — I pulled together the hero, a short benchmark blurb, and three CTA variants (Register, Try Demo, Request Eval). Posting copy below.
Rafael: Perfect, paste the hero + benchmark paragraph so we can sanity-check claims. Also which metric are we highlighting (latency, tokens/sec, cost)?
Olivia: Hero: 'Make LLM inference predictable and affordable — same API, faster tail latency.'
Benchmark blurb: 'In our internal e2e tests, Redwood Reduce cut 99th percentile latency by up to 2.8x on common chat workloads while lowering per-token cost 18% vs baseline configs. Workloads used: multi-turn chat (avg 6 turns), seq len 512, mixed batch sizes.'
Priya: Love the direction. Two quick suggestions: 1) soften "cut" -> "reduced" for marketing/legal, 2) call out the workload shorthand (chat, seq len) in parentheses only, not in headline.
Sam: Ops question — for the webinar CTAs do we want a live-demo seat rota? We need to pin available demo capacity/time zones. If webinar has >100 signups, we'll need 3 concurrent demo slots.
Maya: Quick QA on the benchmark blurb: can we add which model family and whether it was quantized? e.g., tested on open-llm/v1 (int8) — helps set expectations. Also include link to the internal bench notebook.
Olivia: Good call — updated blurb: '...tested on <open-llm/v1, int8 quantized> under mixed-batch scenarios (see internal notebook).' I added a short line about dataset: synthetic dialogue + 5 real app prompts.
Rafael: For CTAs, propose an A/B on button copy + flow mapping: A: "Register for the launch webinar" -> generic webinar list, B: "Claim a demo slot" -> demo-qualified list. We should also route "Request Eval" -> sales SDR queue via HubSpot.
Priya: Agreed. Here's a minimal mapping to hand to growth + ops (CSV for import). Please check fields.
```
cta_text,hubspot_list,utm_campaign,follow_up_flow
Register for the launch webinar,launch_webinar_list,launch_2026_webinar,auto-email-1
Claim a demo slot,demo_slots_list,launch_2026_demo,assign-demo-ops
Request an eval,eval_request_queue,launch_2026_eval,sdrc-sdr-hand-off
```
Rafael: Nice. Add `source=blog_cta` to the UTM. Also recommend tagging variants with `?variant=A`/`?variant=B` for A/B analysis.
Olivia: Will update. Also writing short webinar blurb to include in post: 'Live deep-dive demo + Q&A. Demo slots limited — claim yours in the CTA.'
Sam: I've penciled 3 demo hosts and blocked 2:00pm PT on the calendar. LaunchBot: booked calendar slots for 2026-06-09 14:00 PT, added demo_hosts: Sam, Maya, Jonah.
Maya: LGTM on copy with the quantized model callout. One more: legal wants specificity on "cost" claims. Replace numeric % in headline with 'lower per-token cost in our tests' and keep the 18% in the body with a footnote pointing to the bench notebook.
Olivia: Done — headlines softened, body retains 18% with parenthetical footnote: (see bench notebook).
Priya: Approving content flow from growth side, will export the CSV and hand to growth-ops. Rafael — can you review final CTAs and approve A/B variants by EOD?
Rafael: Will do, aiming to get approvals by 5pm PT. If no objections, we go live with variant A as default and enable variant B after 24 hours for 50/50 testing.
Olivia: Thanks all — next actions: Rafael approve CTAs, Sam confirm demo host calendar invites, Priya export mapping to HubSpot, Maya confirm bench notebook link (and legal quickpass). I'll prep the final copy for publishing once approved. :raised_hands:
